full_prompt_en: A square old-master-style oil painting shows an elderly man in left-facing profile against a nearly black background. His prominent nose, deep-set eye, lined cheek, and long white beard are modeled with warm, directional light. The upper and rear portions of his head are transformed into an extravagant crown of harvest materials. Large yellow pears and round golden fruit sit among ears of grain, pale leaves, cabbage-like rosettes, berries, seed pods, and curled stems. These pieces are not merely a separate wreath: some overlap the temple and ear, while layered foliage merges into a collar around the neck and shoulder. The organic crown occupies the upper half of the composition, its longest stems extending diagonally toward the top right. A richly patterned brown-gold garment appears at the lower right, mostly swallowed by shadow. Lighting comes from the left and above, gilding the fruit skins, leaf edges, forehead, nose, and beard while leaving the back of the head deep in darkness. The palette is earthy and restrained, dominated by ocher, olive, umber, ivory, and a few soft orange highlights. Each botanical component has careful small-scale texture: veins, dry serrated edges, rounded skins, seeds, and wisps of straw. Yet the overall silhouette remains a single readable profile. The background has no landscape, lettering, or decorative frame. The image feels clever and solemn at once, relying on meticulous natural objects assembled into an unexpected human form and revealed through dramatic chiaroscuro.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典油画在近黑背景前呈现一名朝左的老者侧面像。突出的鼻梁、深眼、皱纹脸颊与长白胡须由暖定向光塑形。头的上方与后方化为一顶丰盛的收成材料之冠。大黄梨、圆金果嵌在谷穗、浅叶、卷心菜般叶簇、浆果、种荚与卷曲茎枝中。这些材料不只是另加花环：有些覆盖太阳穴与耳朵，层层叶片又并入颈肩处衣领。植物冠占上半幅，最长茎枝斜向右上。右下有一件纹样丰厚的棕金衣服，大部没入阴影。光从左上进入，给果皮、叶缘、额头、鼻梁和胡须镀上金色，脑后仍深暗。色板质朴克制，以赭黄、橄榄绿、褐色、象牙白和少量柔橙高光为主。每个植物组件都有细密质感：叶脉、干燥锯齿边、圆润果皮、种子与稻草细丝。然而整体轮廓仍是一道清楚可读的侧脸。背景没有风景、文字或装饰框。画面既机巧又肃穆，依靠细致自然物组装出意外的人形，再由戏剧性明暗将其显出。
style_prompt_en: Use meticulous old-master oil-painting detail and deep chiaroscuro to assemble many discrete organic textures into one clear larger silhouette. Paint fruit-like rounded forms, serrated leaves, grain, pods, stems, and woven surfaces with fine veins, skins, and dry edges, allowing parts to overlap and transform one another. Keep the ground nearly black so warm directional light can gild selected planes and leave recesses in shadow. Restrict color to ocher, olive, umber, ivory, and a few muted orange highlights. Balance playful visual transformation with solemn modeling and believable material texture. The final arrangement should reward both distant reading as a unified form and close inspection of its carefully interlocked components.
style_prompt_zh: 用细密的古典油画刻画与深沉明暗法，把许多独立有机纹理组装成一道清楚的大轮廓。描绘果实般圆形、锯齿叶、谷穗、种荚、茎枝与编织表面，显出细叶脉、果皮和干边，让各部分互相覆盖并转化。底色保持近黑，使暖定向光只给选定平面镀金，凹部仍陷在暗处。色彩限于赭黄、橄榄绿、褐色、象牙白与少量低调橙高光。让俏皮的视觉变形与肃穆塑形、可信材料肌理取得平衡。最终排列在远看时是一体形，在近看时又值得检查各个细致相扣的组件。
theme_en: An elderly profile crowned with fruits, leaves, and grain
theme_zh: 由果实、叶片与谷穗环绕的老者侧面像
name: Giuseppe Arcimboldo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
